response.overview: Christmas in the Hood follows two struggling friends who believe their luck has finally changed when they stumble upon a large sum of money. Eager to escape their financial hardships, they quickly spend it - only to discover the cash belongs to a powerful drug lord. With Christmas fast approaching, the pair are thrown into a frantic and hilarious race to repay money that's already gone. As pressure mounts and danger closes in, they must rely on their friendship and wits to survive the holiday season - and the consequences of their choices.
response.title: Christmas in the Hood
